svg.title: Spectral-domain OCT layer probe — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A native broadband source feeds a Michelson-like sample/reference front end. Two sample interfaces and a reference mirror return light to a native spectral receiver. This is the actual ray and spectrum collection front end of an OCT arrangement. The native receiver does not calculate a broadband spectral interferogram, k-linearization, depth reconstruction or axial resolution.
